Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Who do you work with?

We provide dispatch support for owner-operators and fleets. Setup and service suitability depends on the carrier's equipment, authority and operating area.

What equipment do you dispatch?

Our advertised equipment includes Dry Van, Reefer and Flatbed.

What areas do you cover?

We support freight operations in Canada and the USA, including applicable domestic and cross-border lanes.

Can I tell you my preferred lanes?

Yes. Your preferred lanes, home time, equipment and availability are important inputs when searching for freight.
